body: Jan is an open source alternative to ChatGPT that runs 100% offline on your computer.
plain_description: **Run AI models on your computer with more control and privacy.** Download local models or connect cloud AI services. Create assistants and use Jan’s local API with other apps.
technical_description: Jan is a desktop application for downloading and running local LLMs, with optional connections to cloud model providers. It supports custom assistants, MCP integration, and an OpenAI-compatible local server at localhost:1337. The README lists Windows, macOS, and Linux downloads.
title: Jan
